frame.generation: nonzero increasing u64, failure on wrap
frame.fault_visibility: fault reason inspectable after FAILED; no result/PC exposure or resume

observable.yield: SUSPENDED with same accepted message, charged reductions >=1
observable.resume: same frame and message, no side-effect replay
observable.stop: fence new admission; drain admitted in-flight and queued
observable.panic: fence new dispatch and resume; account abandoned; wait for physical quiescence
observable.serial: at most one RUNNING receive per actor incarnation
observable.fault: checked trap persists terminal FAILED and fault code before trapping, no effect replay or new DATA admission
observable.fault_cleanup: FAILED must remain physically quiescent, explicitly closeable and invalid after CLOSE; new incarnation increases generation and clears fault

scope.profile: signed-i64 monotonic accumulator loop with explicit rt cooperate
